title: Initial marker installation
statement: For every Boolean input word $x$, running the transducer for two steps from its initial configuration on $x$ yields the configuration in state $2$, with the input head at the start of $x$, both work-tape heads at cell $0$, and empty output. The first work tape is blank, and the second is blank except for a false marker at offset $-1$.
replaced:
For every input $x$, the first two steps of the clause-splitting transducer from
its initial configuration on $x$ are silent and yield the canonical frame in the
maximum-pass entry state with input head at $0$, empty counter, the empty marked
buffer (blank except for the permanent marker at offset $-1$), both work heads at
$0$, and empty output.
